about: Maria Fashion is a Lebanese online clothing shop whose public Instagram biography lists delivery, exchange within 48 hours and a direct WhatsApp order number. The public collection includes coordinated outfits, knitwear, coats and styling accessories. Confirm current stock, measurements and final order terms directly with the team.

products.name: Zip-Front Coordinated Edit
products.description: Relaxed zip-front top and matching wide-leg trousers shown in olive with front and back photographs, alongside a brown coordinated styling presentation. Ask the team to identify your preferred pictured style and confirm current price, measurements, colours and availability. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Brown Hooded Set
products.description: A brown hooded zip-front top is shown with matching relaxed trousers in a public Reel cover. Confirm current availability, price, measurements and sizing with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Burgundy Knit Skirt Set
products.description: A burgundy button-neck knit top with a matching long skirt, photographed together on hangers. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Contrast Longline Coat
products.description: A black longline coat with a contrasting pale collar, front panel and pocket details. This reference comes from an older public post, so current availability needs confirmation. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Tall Boots Edit
products.description: Two tall black boot styles shown by the page: a chunky-soled pair and a buckle-detail riding-style pair. Choose your reference photograph when enquiring; the photographed bag is styling only unless the team confirms otherwise. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Red Layering Mood
products.description: A red jacket is shown in a coordinated styling board with a cream high-neck top, dark skirt and accessories. The image is styling inspiration rather than a promise that every pictured item is supplied as a set. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Burgundy Layered Coat
products.description: A burgundy textured outer layer over a dark outfit, shown in an outdoor styling photograph. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Long Knit Dress Edit
products.description: Long-sleeved knit dresses shown on hangers in taupe and bright red. Ask the team about the pictured colour and fit. Confirm current availability, price, measurements, sizes and the exact pictured pieces with Maria Fashion. Styling accessories are not automatically included.
